answers.evidence:
All 12 self-tests pass using `go run offbyone.go`. The test suite covers:

| Test | Input | Expected | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Buggy `SumFirstN` with n=len | `[10,20,30,40], n=4` | panic (caught) | ✅ Caught |
| Fixed `SumFirstN` n=2 | `[10,20,30,40], n=2` | 30 | ✅ 30 |
| Fixed `SumFirstN` n=4 | `[10,20,30,40], n=4` | 100 | ✅ 100 |
| Fixed `SumFirstN` n=0 | `[10,20,30,40], n=0` | 0 | ✅ 0 |
| Fixed prefix extraction | `"hello", n=3` | `"hel"` | ✅ `"hel"` |
| Fixed prefix empty n=0 | `"hello", n=0` | `""` | ✅ `""` |
| Fixed prefix full n=len | `"hello", n=5` | `"hello"` | ✅ `"hello"` |
| Days between 1–3 inclusive | a=1, b=3 | 3 | ✅ 3 |
| Days between 1–1 inclusive | a=1, b=1 | 1 | ✅ 1 |
| Days between 5–10 inclusive | a=5, b=10 | 6 | ✅ 6 |
| Pagination buggy (25/10) | total=25, page=10 | 2 (wrong) | ✅ caught |
| Pagination fixed (25/10) | total=25, page=10 | 3 (correct) | ✅ 3 |

Edge cases explicitly tested:
- **n=0** (empty/nil slice – loop never enters, sum = 0)
- **n=len(slice)** (full iteration – buggy version panics, fixed version works)
- **Single-element ranges** (days 1–1: returns 1)
- **Zero-length prefix** (n=0: returns `""`)
- **Pagination with remainder** (25 % 10 ≠ 0: ceiling needed)
